verdict.rationale: Documented support response times per plan tier are a fair question for a SaaS work-management vendor like Asana, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only API, MCP, AI Teammates, integration and deprecation docs, plus unrelated community comments. Nothing documents support tiers, response-time targets or SLAs by plan.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's documented support response times for each plan tier
